scope: Local WARDOGS map, 3D scene, reference-style game artillery and tactical workspace. Not a claim of pixel-perfect rendering or MetaForge cloud-service equivalence.

commands.result: All three maps, original GLBs/LODs, terrain, artillery fixtures, collision, workspace, share and SSE tests passed.
Verified offline staging, version isolation, corrupt-cache repair, unsafe-path rejection and file/directory rollback.
All root JavaScript/MJS files and scripts MJS passed.

passed: Independent dynamic green Sight in 2D and 3D, full-size mode and obstruction warning
Gun and Target viewbar controls place points rather than silently moving the camera
Separate gun-model and target close-up controls
Gun/target dragging, original weapon GLBs and barrel pitch linkage
Pinned arc, named presets, observer correction and coordinate validation
Fly, Walk, gravity, jumping, wall blocking/sliding and loaded-geometry roof support

backupRoundTrip.downloadFallback: Standard download plus visible blob download link, copy button and expandable readonly JSON preview. In-app automatic download/clipboard capture was not treated as a verified file download.

mobileBackup.method: Real CSS viewport inside a 390x844 iframe, not a physical phone

672m structure case, high/low cannon arcs and original gun model pitch changes
Space jump from grounded state, falling and landing
Mobile artillery coordinates and full-size Sight without horizontal overflow
Six-step Quick Guide, found/hidden locations, marker size and named filters
Share restored workspace in a separate origin

passed: Freehand, circles, lines, rectangles, areas, text and icon drawing
Shape movement, vertex reshaping, erasing, cancel, undo and redo
Found/hidden locations, restore, independent area filters and marker size
Named filters, full share state and merge-safe backup preferences
Preset capacity rejects before mutation instead of silent truncation
Local SSE rooms, 409 conflict protection and persisted room data

limitations: No MetaForge login, cloud accounts, paid membership or Steam service integration. Local rooms synchronize tactical drawings on this server only.
No live player or control-zone feed. Source base-map version remains 20260826.
Only Bakurani has verified 2m public source data; Ozeti and Zestafona use 8m data.
Three.js landscape/sky implementation is not an exact Unreal Engine renderer or a pixel-perfect copy.
Trajectory obstruction uses terrain and object bounds; it is not an independent game-engine collision or live-fire verification.
Sight is a game visualization, not a calibrated in-game optic.
Walk roof support uses loaded scene geometry. Device performance and WebGL2 availability vary.
Mobile evidence is iframe-based CSS testing, not all real touch devices. No new V3 long-duration performance benchmark is claimed.
Resource-update rollback was tested offline; no unverified remote production update was invented.
notes: Historical limitations and performance results belong to their earlier validation stages; the added 2m detail, object obstruction, landscape and backup behavior are recorded here.
